name: One match with its replay
description: Two columns out of Postgres: replay_key for the presign task, and the whole response. `rating_change` is null until count has folded the match, which is why status is shown beside it -- a competitor sees the result before they see what it did to their rating. A cancelled match carries withdrawn_reason and, where a promotion caused it, the successor that replaced the seat; a failed one carries the fault and which seat it was attributed to. replay_url is null for any row that never produced a replay.

input.query: SELECT mt.replay_key, json_build_object( 'id', mt.id, 'game', g.slug, 'season', (SELECT se.number FROM seasons se WHERE se.id = mt.season_id), 'status', mt.status, 'seed', mt.seed, 'preset', mt.preset, 'reason', mt.reason, 'turns', mt.turns, 'played_ms', mt.played_ms, 'played_at', mt.played_at, 'created_at', mt.created_at, 'withdrawn_reason', mt.withdrawn_reason, 'successor_id', mt.successor_id, 'fault_reason', mt.fault_reason, 'fault_seat', mt.fault_seat, 'engine_digest', mt.engine_digest_played, 'evaluator_digest', mt.evaluator_digest, 'is_trial', mt.trial_model_id IS NOT NULL, 'ladders', array_to_json(mt.ladders), 'strike_limit', ($2)::int, 'successor', (SELECT json_build_object('model_id', sm.id, 'owner', su.handle, 'version', sm.version) FROM models sm JOIN users su ON su.id = sm.owner_id WHERE sm.id = mt.successor_id), 'players', (SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object( 'seat', s.seat, 'model_id', s.model_id, 'owner', s.owner, 'baseline', s.baseline, 'class', s.class, 'model_version', s.version, 'outcome', s.outcome, 'rank', s.rank, 'score', s.score, 'strikes', s.strikes, 'rating_change', (SELECT json_object_agg(e.ladder, json_build_object( 'mu_before', e.mu_before, 'sigma_before', e.sigma_before, 'mu_after', e.mu_after, 'sigma_after', e.sigma_after)) FROM rating_events e WHERE e.match_id = mt.id AND e.seat = s.seat)) ORDER BY s.seat), '[]'::json) FROM match_seat_rows(mt.id, ($2)::int) s)) AS body FROM matches mt JOIN games g ON g.id = mt.game_id WHERE mt.id = ($1)::uuid
